$comment: Pinned tool versions of the release pipeline. The scripts refuse any other Rojo version (Validate-Release.ps1); scripts/release/Install-Tools.ps1 downloads exactly these release assets into .tools/ and checks their SHA-256 before unpacking. An empty sha256 means: not verified yet - Install-Tools refuses to install that asset until the hash is filled in (fill it from a download you checked by hand, see docs/RELEASE_PROCESS.md). The hashes below were taken on 2026-11-16 from the GitHub release assets.

githubActions.$comment: Actions are referenced by commit SHA in .github/workflows; the tag is only a note.
